scientific_integrity: General Huffer–Lin exponential-linear-form exact algorithm is prior art; no novelty claim for generic exact computability. New target is the statistic-specific closed form with paired endpoint tail laws and strict stochastic shift. Independent mathematical priority and correctness audit are not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite n,m,r; exactly exponential null, independent lifetimes, noninformative removal; no fixed-alternative power or growing-sample theorem. Signed partial fractions may be numerically unstable without rational/high precision.
title: Exact finite-sample calibration and asymmetric tails of a progressively censored exponentiality statistic
